cases.question: How do the two fan curve options compare?

research.need: how the two fan curves compare

items.label: Fan curve review
items.text: Two fan curves were compared under the soak load. Curve v1, the current curve, keeps noise at 32 dBA but peaks at 78°C. Curve v2 peaks at 71°C, raises noise to 36 dBA and needs firmware 2.3. The review approved curve v2 for DVT.

items.title: Curve v2 noise above target
items.text: Curve v2 measures 36 dBA against a 35 dBA target.
